transcript.content: Hi, welcome. What brings you in today?
I guess I’m here because I feel… wound up a lot. Like my body’s always bracing for something bad, even when I’m just sitting at work or trying to relax. It’s been hard to ignore.
Did something traumatic happen to you before you started feeling this way?
Not that I can think of. I mean… nothing big or obvious happened before it started. It just kind of crept up, I guess.
Do you get sudden episodes of intense fear or panic that come on quickly?
I don’t think so… not like a sudden panic attack or anything. It’s more just… feeling tense, I guess.
Do you feel especially anxious when you’re around other people or being watched by them?
Um… not especially, no. I mean, I can feel awkward sometimes like anyone, but I don’t think being around people or being watched is the main thing.
Do you find yourself worrying about lots of different things in your life?

Yeah… I guess I do. It doesn’t really stay on one thing. I’ll worry about the condo, then it’s whether my cousin is upset with me, or if I’m going to mess up on a support call, or money and… where my life is going. It kind of jumps around.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
I don’t know… not really depressed, I guess. Maybe tired or kind of worn down sometimes, but I wouldn’t say down exactly.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying that you might have a serious illness?
Not really. I mean, I’ll worry if something feels off, but I don’t spend a lot of time thinking I have some serious illness.
